summary: Build an Empire in the Desert and Dunes
description:
Create and grow your own thriving empire — start small, stack up, and watch your city come to life with new buildings, resources, and upgrades!

🌍  CUSTOMIZE
Stack houses to form cool vibrant city.
Unlock several different types of buildings.
Move your buildings to create your perfect layout.
Change villager skins to personalize your city.
Buy decorations like amusement park rides and more.
Total landscaping freedom in the end game

🔍 EXPLORE
Send explorers on expeditions to gather resources and discover treasures.
Discover new feature buildings as your city expands

👤 MANAGE
Assign your villagers to work to optimize resource production.
Command them to gather resources around your city

👥 VISITORS
Fulfill visitor requests and trade resources with them.
Decorate your city to see visitors interact with it

💫REBUILD
Sell your old city to restart building a new one.
Unlock a reset feature that grants permanent perks (bonuses).
Discover new map themes with reset

✨ Idle City Builder offers all this — and much more!
 Build, manage, explore, and create the city of your dreams!
